note: 23 Aug march from the Corwin to Herald Square: tenants, garment operators, florists, merchants.

lines.text: We live here! We stay here!
Mrs. Pruitt's in front. Keep up with Mrs. Pruitt.
Operators! Local's here! Feld owes us!
Flowers for the marchers! Moretti says take one!
My first march since the war. The other war.
Hot. Very hot. Righteous, but hot.
Who owns the Tenderloin? We do!
Sorry, sorry. Big crowd. Good crowd.
Somebody from the paper's taking pictures. Smile like a tenant.
